title: Number input
description: A number you step with two chevrons or type; the digits roll to the new value with NumberFlow, as an odometer does, so you see what changed and which way. Arrow keys step (Shift: ten steps; Home and End: the bounds), a chevron held keeps stepping, and the field never holds an invalid value: typed text is taken as soon as it reads as a number and clamped when you leave. Formats through Intl.NumberFormat (locale, currency, decimals). AnimatedNumber, the rolling digits, is exported on its own for a counter that only shows.
